INSERT INTO user_notification_item_unsubscribe (user_id, item_id, item_type, snoozed_until)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
               ON CONFLICT (user_id, item_id) DO UPDATE
               SET item_type = EXCLUDED.item_type, snoozed_until = EXCLUDED.snoozed_until,
                   mentions_only = FALSE
